input: Sort out travel visa for Japan trip

gold.taskTitle: Sort Out Travel Visa for Japan Trip
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to obtain a travel visa to visit Japan and needs a clear plan to get it sorted.

questions.title: What is your current citizenship or passport nationality?
questions.description: Knowing the user's nationality determines whether they even need a visa for Japan, as many countries are visa-exempt.

questions.title: What is the intended purpose of your Japan visit?
questions.description: Tourism, business, study, and work each require a different visa category with different requirements.

questions.title: What are your planned travel dates to Japan?
questions.description: The departure date sets the deadline for the visa application and affects processing time urgency.

questions.title: How long do you plan to stay in Japan?
questions.description: Length of stay determines the appropriate visa duration and whether a single or multiple-entry visa is needed.

questions.title: Have you applied for a Japanese visa before?
questions.description: Prior experience with the process helps identify whether the user needs full guidance or just specific steps.

questions.title: Which country will you be submitting the application from?
questions.description: The country of application determines which Japanese embassy or consulate handles the process and its specific requirements.

questions.title: Do you have a valid passport with sufficient expiry remaining?
questions.description: A passport's validity and available blank pages are a baseline requirement before any visa application can proceed.
